thread:
Nina (CSE): FYI ACME mobile reports intermittent 429s during iOS SDK init (only on first few minutes of a rollout). also saw occasional 401 right after token rotate.
Omar (Eng): can you paste a minimal client log snippet and response headers?
Nina (CSE): logs below — root calls to /v1/init, same code path, nothing fancy:
```
Request: POST /v1/init  Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral-token>
Response: 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 120
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 1699999999
---
Then ~3s later a 401 appears during a refresh: 401 Unauthorized token_expired
```
Jun (Support): sounds like a hot-start stampede + short-lived tokens. Are they calling init on every view/controller mount?
Nina (CSE): they call in AppDelegate didFinishLaunching and again when a new chat session spawns for each user. token TTL is 5m, they rotate aggressively.
Omar (Eng): two angles: client-side debounce/singleflight + server-side warmup policy. Which SDK version are they on?
Nina (CSE): 0.9.0 (from March). they tried simple exponential backoff + jitter, still saw bursts.
Jun (Support): we shipped a client fix in 0.9.3 that reuses init tokens for short windows and exposes `init_debounce_ms`. Ask them to upgrade and set `init_debounce_ms: 3000`. Should cut parallel inits.
Omar (Eng): on infra we can temporarily raise their quota or add a short warmup bypass for known customer ids to prevent 429s during onboarding — requires SRE approval. I'll open a ticket.
deploy-bot: Deploy request created: infra/issue-#1247 — proposed warmup-bypass for account 34721. Canary window scheduled 2024-11-20T14:00Z. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/warmup-bypass
Liz (CSM): ACME confirmed they can test tonight at 22:00 PST after upgrading SDK. I'll coordinate release notes and a short support window. :thumbsup:
Omar (Eng): created eng-infra ticket and asked SRE for a temporary quota bump (account 34721). tagging @eng-sre.
Nina (CSE): thanks — i'll send them the 0.9.3 client artifact + suggested config snippet:
```
// iOS config
RedwoodSDK.configure(
  apiKey: "<ephemeral>",
  initDebounceMs: 3000,
  autoRetry: true
)
```
Jun (Support): after upgrade, ask ACME to run the small ramp test (10 devices -> 100 -> 1k) and capture x-rate-limit-* headers. we can correlate with infra metrics.
Nina (CSE): ACME agrees. i'll post results here after the 22:00 test. thanks all. :pray:
